definitions.explanation: A telephone connected by a physical line to a fixed location, as opposed to a mobile phone. Increasingly uncommon in Japanese households but still used in business settings.

examples.japanese: {固定電話|こていでんわ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦{使|つか}っていない→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: I don't use a landline anymore.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{固定電話|こていでんわ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{電話|でんわ}して→電話する：05652_denwasuru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。

{若|わか}い⟦{世代|せだい}→世代：05102_sedai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{固定電話|こていでんわ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}た→持つ：00478_motsu⟧ず、⟦{携帯|けいたい}→携帯：00715_keitai⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{済|す}ませる→済む：01950_sumu⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Younger generations often get by with just a mobile phone, without having a landline.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{固定|こてい}→固定：10996_kotei⟧ (fixed) + ⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧ (telephone). Contrasts with ⟦{携帯電話|けいたいでんわ}→携帯電話：04433_keitaidenwa⟧ (mobile phone) and ⟦スマホ→スマホ：04721_sumaho⟧ (smartphone).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {固定電話|こていでんわ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{番号|ばんごう}→番号：02939_bangou⟧: landline number
- {固定電話|こていでんわ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧: to install a landline
- {固定電話|こていでんわ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{解約|かいやく}→解約：06129_kaiyaku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to cancel a landline

CULTURAL NOTE:
Landline numbers start with area codes (e.g., 03 for ⟦{東京|とうきょう}→東京：09564_toukyou⟧, 06 for ⟦{大阪|おおさか}→大阪：09779_oosaka⟧). Ownership was once important for credit checks and official registrations, but mobile phones have largely replaced them.

ALTERNATE NAMES:
- {家電|いえでん}: home phone (colloquial abbreviation)
- ⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧: house phone
